label: Freeform patch
tooltip: Fit a B-spline surface to a region of the scan, for example to split a body.
help: Mark the triangles of a curved surface with the brush or smart select, or choose a region. The surface is fitted as a height field and extended by the margin beyond the triangles, so it splits a body reliably. The span count is chosen automatically; more spans follow the scan more closely, stronger smoothing bridges gaps. Before OK, check that at least 95 % of the triangles are within the tolerance.
inputMissing: Mark triangles with the brush or smart select, or choose a region (at least {{min}}).

result.poorFit: Only {{share}} % of the triangles are within the tolerance of ±{{tolerance}}. Use more spans, less smoothing or a smaller selection.
